reasoning: Both models consistently found PKGBUILD and .install scripts safe with sound reasoning. PKGBUILD uses pinned HTTPS sources with checksums and performs benign file operations. The .install script handles standard systemd service management without dangerous operations.
coverage_issues: Both models skipped 29 unauditable files (prebuilt binaries/archives). While expected for -bin packages, this leaves payload unaudited.
false_negatives: Prebuilt binaries were not analyzed (inherent tool limitation). Could contain malware, though unrelated to packaging scripts.
No model reviewed systemd service files (e.g., rustdesk.service) referenced in PKGBUILD, though low-risk as they're installed without modification.
learnings: Prioritize reviewing referenced systemd/service files in PKGBUILD install commands
Improve reporting clarity: explicitly state binary payloads are unaudited and highlight trust dependency on upstream
Add lightweight binary checks (e.g., strings/entropy scan) to flag suspicious payloads
